senses.gloss: m. (= מעדן; b. h. מעדנות; עָדַן, Hif.) knot in reed-matting.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 11:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. XI, 12</cite> <he>טפחיים בין מדין למ׳</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 20:7">Kel. XX, 7</cite> <he>מדן</he>) two handbreadths of matting between each two knots.—Pl. <he>מַדַּנִּים</he>, <he>מַדַּנִּין</he>, <he>מַעֲדַנִּ׳</he>. Ib. 11 <he>עד שלא קשר ראשי מ׳</he> (not <he>קצר</he>; R. S. l. c. <cite ref="M02189"><he>מע׳</he></cite>) before he knotted the tops of the knots. Ib. VII, 11 [read:] <he>משיקשור ראשי המ׳ שלה</he> (v. R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Kel. XVII, 17</cite>).
<cite ref="Sukkah 13b:3">Succ. 13ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. II, end, 52ᶜ <cite ref="M02189"><he>מע׳</he></cite>.
